caption:
MW4 aim assist: best settings 🎮 There is no aim assist type in Modern Warfare 4 – no Black Ops, Precision or Focusing to pick. Keep Target Aim Assist on, run the Dynamic response curve with Instant ADS transition and set your stick deadzone just above drift. Since Nov 12/13 aim assist is off through Smoke Grenades and the Smoke Wall in multiplayer and Warzone. Pad or mouse? Comment below 👇 Save this for your next match & send it to your squad!
